_comment: Example KDPS add-on: Redis from the redis chart, installed as /var/lib/ambari-server/resources/kdps-addons/REDIS_DEMO. See docs/ADDONS.md.
label: Redis (add-on example)
description: A single Redis server, installed from an add-on package rather than with KDPS itself.
